subject: TwoFold demo scheduling — CTO window and exec intro
messages:
From: Ava Reynolds <ava.reynolds@twofold.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lisa Evans <lisa.evans@twofold.ai>
Date: 2028-08-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Requesting a demo — need CTO present for architecture discussion

Hi Mina / Rishi,

Thanks for the quick responses on the intake call earlier. We'd like to schedule a full demo focused on deployment topology and security for our CTO and engineering leads. The CTO (Arjun) is only available in the early-evening PT window next week due to travel — ideally a 2-hour block so we can walk through the architecture, questions, and next steps with the broader team. Proposed windows (PT):

- Thu 7 Sep 2028, 17:00–19:00 PT
- Fri 8 Sep 2028, 18:00–20:00 PT

If the full CTO can't make both, we'd still like an executive intro (VP/CIO level) to kick things off. I'll attach the SOW we shared internally so you have context.

Also: two asks — (1) can you include an exec sponsor from Redwood for the intro, and (2) please flag any network/firewall requirements for the demo so our infra folks (CC'd Lisa) can prep.

Attachments: TwoFold-SOW-v1.pdf (SOW, high level)

Looking forward,
Ava
Ava Reynolds
Director, Cloud Platforms
TwoFold AI
ava.reynolds@twofold.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Reynolds <ava.reynolds@twofold.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-08-30T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Requesting a demo — need CTO present for architecture discussion

Hi Ava — thanks for the clear windows and the SOW. Happy to run this and make sure the session covers both the architecture deep dive and the business outcomes you care about. A few quick notes / asks:

- We can do Thu 7 Sep 17:00–19:00 PT; please confirm and we'll send a calendar invite.
- For the exec intro: I can bring Ben Carter (our VP of Sales) to do the commercial intro and hand off to Rishi for the technical portion. If Arjun (CTO) can join briefly at the top of the session, we’ll give an architecture overview at 17:10 and then go deep.
- Rishi — will you be able to lead the deep technical walkthrough if Arjun can only join later?
- Attaching a draft agenda (demo-agenda-v0.2.docx).

Also, could you share the contact who would own network access (VPN/firewall) so we can coordinate? If there's any AD/SSO integration talk expected, let us know now so we can have the right SMEs on the call.

I’ll tentatively hold the Thu slot and send an invite once you confirm.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com
Office: +1 (650) 555-0199

Date: 2028-08-30T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Requesting a demo — need CTO present for architecture discussion

Mina / Ava —

I can absolutely run the technical deep dive. If Arjun is only available for part of the session we should:

- Start with a 10-minute exec intro (Ben) + 5–10 minute CTO remarks (Arjun) if he can join.
- Do a 60–75 minute demo focused on topology, KV cache behavior, and routing/fallbacks.
- Reserve 20–30 minutes for integration questions and a runbook for the PoC.

If you prefer a compressed session we can do 60 minutes on live demo and follow with a smaller workshop for infra. I’ll plan to bring diagrams and the deployment matrix.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Principal Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com

From: Ava Reynolds <ava.reynolds@twofold.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lisa Evans <lisa.evans@twofold.ai>
Date: 2028-08-30T16:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Requesting a demo — need CTO present for architecture discussion

Thanks Mina / Rishi — Thu 7 Sep 17:00–19:00 PT works best for us.

Couple of requests so we have the right people:

- Please schedule the first 10 minutes for an exec intro (VP/CIO/CTO) so the leadership context is clear. If Arjun can only join at 17:30, that's fine — but we'd like the CTO to at least open and set acceptance criteria if possible.
- Please include a mutual action plan doc (we use a short checklist for PoC milestones). I attached our POC checklist so you can see the items we'll hold you to during evaluation.
- Please note: during the demo we will touch on some code-level integration details. For security/compliance reasons we prefer the recording to be turned off during those sections; can you confirm if Redwood can support pausing recording?

Attachments: TwoFold-POC-Checklist.xlsx

I'll confirm Arjun's availability by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Ava

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ava Reynolds <ava.reynolds@twofold.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-08-31T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Confirmed: Thu 7 Sep 2028, 17:00–19:00 PT — agenda + attendees

Ava / Lisa —

Thanks — booking confirmed for Thu 7 Sep 17:00–19:00 PT. Calendar invite (redwood-invite.ics) attached. Final notes:

- Attendees (confirmed / tentatively invited): Ava Reynolds (TwoFold), Lisa Evans (TwoFold), Mina Haddad (Redwood, SE), Rishi Malhotra (Redwood, Tech Lead), Ben Carter (Redwood, Executive Sponsor), Arjun Patel (TwoFold CTO) — pending Arjun's final RSVP.
- Agenda (high level): 17:00–17:10 Exec intro; 17:10–18:20 Architecture + live demo; 18:20–18:45 Integration & network runbook; 18:45–19:00 Mutual action plan & next steps.
- Recording: we can pause/disable recording during specific segments. Ben, can you confirm policy on that?
- Networking: Ava — please send the name/email of your network engineer so we can exchange firewall IPs and test connectivity prior to the call.
- Pre-reads: I've attached the draft agenda; Rishi will circulate the deployment matrix and a short slide on KV/cache behavior before the session.

Related links: HubSpot record and DocuSign path added to the invite.

If anything changes on your side, please flag it — otherwise we’ll send the final invite with dial-in and calendar details this afternoon.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com
